scope: 04 only. Frozen seven-site direct-contact cavity in the (2 vacancies,2 A,3 B) sector. No training, simulation, TEST-based selection or paid compute; no 05.
population: Unchanged eligible exterior and one-star-per-parent weighting from 03. Audit both TRAIN and TEST in full; counterfactual measurements on all eligible TEST exteriors only (8192 each b00..b07, 8190 b08, 8187 b09). Three starts share parents. These TEST parents are reused intentionally, not a new exam.
intervention: All-empty exterior as the reference Hamiltonian, not a sampled boundary. Keep intrinsic H0=sum n(s-ell)^2. Set U=sum n(d²-2d ell)+sum_ext n_u[2(a_u-ell_u)+1]D_u; Jin=2 sum n d s; Jout=sum_ext n_u D_u(D_u-1), D_u=sum cavity occupations adjacent to u. Ignore only state-independent constants. Profile H0+U+lambda*(Jin+Jout), lambda=0,.25,.5,.75,1, at all ten beta. Also H0 alone, H0+U+Jin only (delete Jout), H0+U+Jout only (delete Jin) at every beta. No changing empirical boundary weights. No equilibrium or gauge-invariant attribution under modified Hamiltonians.
operators: Fixed center-vacancy indicator, frozen 03 TRAIN-selected full site-linear scalar, and the three 03 final deterministic hard maps with their original TRAIN-fitted four-label contrasts (seeds 6101/6102/6103; 10257 updates b00..b08, 10218 b09). No relabeling or refitting. Constant code has zero usable variance and undefined T and differences, not estimated T=0. Zero-boundary-memory scalar with positive variance has T=0.
primary: At beta=3.05 the signed change is full MINUS fields-only T, T=Var_B(E[f|B])/Var(f). For each fixed fit, pointwise two-sided 95% t interval from the paired exterior influence-function differences as in 03. Practical margin +/-0.01 absolute T. Interval wholly above +.01 or below -.01 => material increase/decrease. Wholly inside (-.01,.01) => practically equivalent. Otherwise unresolved at this margin, even if statistically nonzero. Claim a shared learned response only if all three seeds meet the same classification. No pooling or best seed; other beta/lambda/component profiles descriptive, not independent hypothesis hunts.
secondary: Report both between-exterior variance and marginal total variance separately for each operator/law, their paired shifts, T and its paired differences. For each counterfactual vs full law compute per-parent Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits for the 210 states and after projection onto each of the three unchanged hard category partitions (not the scalar); verify data processing per parent. Report means, matched parent intervals and conditional whole-state coincidence sum p². Neither JS nor changes in T are fractions of mutual information. Components can compensate. No state-space effect will be inferred from saturation of one scalar.
gates: Before perturbation scoring, require integer equality after subtracting each boundary row minimum on every evaluated state/parent on both sides. Require pinned geometry/rosters. At full strength require rows equal archived conditional laws (max abs 2e-14), matching definedness and 03 frozen final hard T and 95% endpoints, static reference T and intervals (abs 1e-9); check stochastic final as integrity only. All beta-zero laws uniform (1e-14) and all nonconstant T zero; H0-only same law for every parent and T zero wherever defined (1e-12). JS in [0,1] and projected <= full pathwise (2e-12 roundoff). Abort on mismatch: no redefinition or substitution. No new physical or trained states.
